basic_profile.bio: An avid Monster Hunter enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest, I spend my evenings dissecting game mechanics and optimizing weapon builds. My interests span from tabletop games like Exploding Kittens to analyzing atmospheric phenomena. By day, I'm a software developer working on cloud solutions, and by night, I hunt monsters online. I'm single, enjoy crafting artisanal coffee, and am typically active on Reddit during late-night hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Started gaming with the Monster Hunter series back in 2018. Over the years, I've delved deep into the mechanics, particularly focusing on elemental builds for weaponry. My knowledge stems from countless hours of gameplay, community discussions, and strategy guides.
